text:
alex: Heads-up: PR #9142 is ready for review but I'm holding merge until architecture signoff on the new routing strategy. RFC here: https://redwood.dev/rfcs/rt-2026-routing-strategy (summary below). Can someone from arch take a look? :eyes:
jeanne: Link doesn't render for me, can you paste a short TL;DR?
alex: TL;DR: move per-customer routing policy to control plane, allow policy overrides per-route, fallback to cheaper model variants when capacity is tight. Main risk is syncing policy updates without request loss. Added sequence diagram and a short state machine in the RFC.
sam: Is this the change that alters KV cache keys? If keys change we'll invalidate caches across nodes — need a migration plan.
chris: Also need perf numbers for typical 2k/4k seq loads. What's the latency/regression impact? Please add a small bench and results in the PR description.
alex: Good calls. Quick bench I just ran on a single 3090 replica (dev harness):
```
$ bench/run_routing_bench.sh --seq 2000 --runs 50
baseline p95: 46ms
patched p95: 62ms
baseline p50: 18ms
patched p50: 24ms
```
PR now points to the bench script at `bench/run_routing_bench.sh`. Will add the full logs and CI workflow to reproduce. I'll also include migration steps for cache keys.
jeanne: Can you also add a compatibility matrix for old control-plane clients vs new policy API? Need explicit fallback behavior spelled out.
alex: Yup. Current plan: if control-plane rejects an updated policy, runtime falls back to the per-route default model and emits telemetry `routing.policy.rejects`. I'll add that matrix + state transitions to the PR and RFC.
sam: @jeanne @chris — is a simple ACK in this thread enough for the PR bot, or do we need formal signoff on the RFC page too?
chris: Architect signoff is required for infra-affecting changes. We need an ACK on the RFC (comment + :white_check_mark: on the RFC doc) and a PR approval. I can take a look after you add the bench logs and the compatibility matrix.
infra-bot: PR 9142: review required: arch, runtime. Label `awaiting-arch` added.
alex: Thanks — I'll update the PR within the hour with logs, compatibility matrix, and the migration plan. If helpful I can do a 10m sync to walk through the sequence diagram.
jeanne: :thumbsup: ping me when it's updated and I'll skim the matrix.
